dod_intent_evidence: Their own SBIR abstract ('Commercial NIIRS 7 Imagery for Government ISR', Air Force 2022, $1,249,211) plus a homepage 'Contracted by NRO / Space Force / AFRL / NASA JPL' line and news of a $12M AFRL STRATFI (March 2025) and an NRO Stage 2 imagery contract (August 2025).
score_evidence: '4x improvement in Resolution & closing RF links / 16x improvement in active signal returns / Faster intercept times' and 'nanoradian-class stability' — multiplier and spec bragging with no mission-outcome or fielding framing → lab_language_intensity
Zero occurrences of ATO, RMF, IL5, CMMC, ITAR, STIG, or any ground-segment accreditation language across ~1367 words of a company selling imagery to NRO and AFRL → deployment_awareness_absence

'Full-stack services for payload integration, launch, and mission ops' is the closest thing to an end user; no analyst, collection manager, tasking cell, warfighter, training, or field-feedback language anywhere → operator_absence

Ten open roles are all bus/payload domain engineering (Lead Electrical, Senior Firmware, Senior GNC, Lead Thermal, GNSS Navigation, Senior RF Systems, Director of Hardware) plus recruiters — no ground-software, mission-ops, test/integration, or security/compliance hire → hiring_profile_skew

'Albedo secures $12 million STRATFI contract' (2025-03-04) with Clarity-1 launched the same month and the next mission 'Vicinity' announced 2026-04-07 → stage_pressure (STRATFI match-and-transition clock running against a second-vehicle build)

blind_spots.blind_spot: Sells a direct-to-tactical-user link without naming a terminal, waveform, or TAK path
blind_spots.operator_reality: The 'handheld' in a dismounted squad is an EUD running ATAK with a specific radio, crypto load, and an approved waveform — it does not accept an arbitrary satellite link. And from 275 km the bird is overhead for a few minutes per pass, so 'low-latency connectivity' to that user is a pass-scheduling problem, not a bandwidth problem. Nothing in the pack names a terminal, a waveform, ATAK/TAK, or a revisit model.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The team's heritage listed on the site is Lockheed Martin Space, SpaceX, and NASA JPL — space-segment builders, whose customer has always been a ground station, never a sergeant with a battery budget.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Direct to Device — Low-latency connectivity directly to handhelds, vehicles, and tactical systems. R² performance gains enable lower power links, smaller terminals, and reliable coverage.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The entire ground segment and dissemination path is missing from a company already under an NRO contract
blind_spots.operator_reality: 10 cm imagery becomes ISR only after it lands in an accredited ground system at the right classification and flows into the customer's existing GEOINT dissemination chain. That is an ATO/RMF package, a classified enclave, ITAR/CUI handling for the raw collection, and an interface to government back-end systems — the part of the program that eats the schedule while the STRATFI period of performance burns down.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Clarity-1 proved the sensor, which is what the engineering org was built to prove; the ground/accreditation work has no owner in a company whose entire hiring plan is buses and payloads.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Full-stack services for payload integration, launch, and mission ops.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No tasking cycle or CONOPS — the sensor is described, the collection manager's workflow is not
blind_spots.operator_reality: An ISR customer buys against time-to-product inside their existing tasking cycle: submit a collection request, get a prioritized deck, receive an exploitable product with metadata their tools accept. Resolution multipliers do not move that number; tasking latency, revisit, and cloud-free access do. A VLEO constellation of 24 with narrow swath makes revisit the binding constraint, and the pack never mentions revisit, tasking, or delivery timeline once.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The 2022 SBIR was written to win on resolution ('a significant resolution improvement over any currently available commercial systems'), so resolution stayed the organizing metric through Clarity-1 and into the marketing.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Albedo is designing and building a very low earth orbit (VLEO) constellation of twenty-four 10 cm GSD electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) satellites to create a significant resolution improvement over any currently available commercial systems.

opener_hook: Albedo lists 'Direct to Device — low-latency connectivity directly to handhelds, vehicles, and tactical systems' as one of five VLEO missions on albedo.com, alongside a $12M AFRL STRATFI and an NRO Stage 2 award, but the site never names a terminal, a waveform, or a TAK path — and at 275 km the dismounted user has that satellite overhead for minutes per pass.
what_they_do: Builds very-low-Earth-orbit satellites and buses that deliver 10 cm imaging, RF sensing, and active sensing for government ISR customers.
